note: Gap junctions known from physiology/genetics but invisible in EM connectomes. Modelled as true electrical coupling: a presynaptic spike adds 'coupling_mv' directly to the postsynaptic membrane voltage on the next 0.5 ms step (shaders/lif.glsl mode 2), giving the ~1 ms latency and 1:1 following reported for the giant-fibre system. basis: literature (existence, 1:1 following, latency) + calibrated (coupling strength: one presynaptic spike lifts the postsynaptic cell from its actual resting potential just above threshold: 7 mV threshold gap + 8 mV resting offset of the quiescent escape motor neurons (data/physiology_rules.json) + 1 mV = 16 mV; 2026-10-09, before: 8 mV, which gave only ~0.3 TTMn spikes per GF spike instead of the measured 1:1).
